note: BiRefNet cutout from open-higgsfield-skills @5a1a2d4 (MIT, rossaai/rosesfield); the BiRefNet weights are reported MIT but unverified. ComfyUI core LoadBackgroundRemovalModel/RemoveBackground produce the foreground mask; GetImageSize/EmptyImage build a solid fill at the source size and ImageCompositeMasked lays the cutout over it. The image parameter is the uploaded still and colour is the solid RGB fill (0xRRGGBB).
